question: Should this protected, large recovery refactor land after a refreshed maintainer review and a real restart-recovery proof, or should it be narrowed further before merge?
rationale: The PR changes a session-state recovery path and is explicitly labeled `maintainer`; automated checks support the direction but cannot establish the intended owner-level acceptance of the split boundaries or replace a real recovery scenario.

options.title: Review and land with live proof
options.body: Recommended: confirm the entry-point and cross-module recovery contracts on the current merge result, then accept a redacted real Gateway restart/recovery transcript or terminal run.

options.title: Request a narrower split
options.body: Ask for a smaller phase extraction if maintainers consider the replay and persistence changes too coupled for one refactor PR.
